name: Flaming Chef (CR 15) — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Flaming Chef (CR 8)", "Flaming Chef (CR 25)" but are not part of the Flaming Chef (CR 15) entry, which is unchanged.

ABOUT

As his culinary fame and alchemical prowess grew, Jockel became an accomplished hero, wielding his battlepot cauldron with lethal efficiency and delivering fiery concoctions against oppressive tyrants.

ABOUT

Reaching god-like culinary supremacy, the Flaming Chef is a legendary master of both the kitchen and battlefield. Immune to magma and blazing heat, he wields his mythical enchanted skillet and supreme alchemical draughts to vanquish the most terrifying monsters across the planes.
